literature_selection_rule: Include respected original literature only for a named, assessed learning goal. Do not add poetry, fiction, or other material merely as corpus filler.
title: Kavi model curriculum: multilingual original works, traditions, and textbook candidates
selection_basis: This is a prerequisite graph, not a ranking of nations, cultures, or people. Shared signal, script, quantity, language, and verification skills come first. Source lanes at the same level are parallel; each may unlock only after its own language lane, source review, and domain prerequisites pass.
admission_rule: Every entry is catalog metadata only. No work may become training text until its exact edition or witness, jurisdiction, rights, provenance, applicable cultural protocol, local extract fingerprint, lesson verifier, protected retention test, and held-out evaluation have passed review.
original_language_rule: When available, the original title, language, and script are recorded. The original is the reference point; a translation or transliteration is a separately reviewed aid, not a replacement. A modern digital edition or scan is a distinct witness with its own terms.
access_rule: Candidate URLs are access records only. They do not authorize crawling, scraping, copying, or training. See curriculum/access-records.json and docs/DOCUMENT_CURRICULUM_GATE.md.
